summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DOH (Days on Hand) Analysis page (Iteration 11). All backend APIs working correctly (19/19 tests passed). Frontend UI fully functional with PRD Formula cards (3), KPI cards (4), charts (2), data tables (2), configurable ideal DOH slider (1-60 days), and CSV export. FilterPanel integrates correctly. Navigation sidebar includes DOH Analysis. Existing Replenishment Planner and Stock-Out Analysis pages still work (regression).

context_for_next_testing_agent: DOH Analysis page fully implemented and tested at /doh. Backend endpoint /api/analytics/doh returns summary, store_data, category_data, trend_data, detail, and recommendations arrays. Accepts ideal_doh (default 9) query param which recalculates classification using PRD formulas: DOH = Inventory / Daily ROS, Channel DOH = Sum(DOH x Inv) / Sum(Inv), Classification: Optimal ±20% of ideal, Overstocked >120%, Understocked <80%. Frontend uses Chart.js components (LineChart, BarChart, DoughnutChart from /app/frontend/src/components/Charts.js). FilterPanel component integrates correctly. All existing pages (Stock-Out Analysis, Replenishment Planner) still work. Data is NOT mocked - uses real uploaded CSV data.
